content: JitPack BUILDING.md: multi-module individual artifacts = com.github.User.Repo:Module:Tag; plain com.github.User:Repo resolves to generated aggregator depending on all modules. Build env vars JITPACK=true, GROUP, ARTIFACT, VERSION (tag or commit), GIT_COMMIT. JitPack rewrites POMs for inter-module deps (issue #4112 unpredictable), generated Gradle .module metadata can be wrong (issue #4476, workaround disable GenerateModuleMetadata when JITPACK set). Local ecosystem: stt-engine multi-module consumed as com.github.Ygaray.voice-engine-android:<artifactId>:vX.
